## About Me

I am a **PhD Scholar** at the **All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)**, New Delhi, specializing in the intersection of **Molecular Biology** and **Bioinformatics**.
My research work integrates **transcriptomics (RNA-Seq)** and clinical data to decipher the molecular landscape of **B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (B-ALL)** within the Indian population. By integrating large-scale RNA-Seq data with clinical outcomes, my aim is to uncover diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers that can improve treatment strategies.

With a "wet-to-dry" lab skillset, I am passionate about bridging the gap between raw genomic data and meaningful clinical insights. I am currently seeking **Postdoctoral opportunities** where I can apply my expertise to uncover novel insights in precision medicine and disease mechanisms.
